plugin_pay.title: Payment Hub
plugin_pay.description: Payment orders, refunds, callbacks, channels, authorizations, reconciliation and settlements (tenant-scoped money facts)
plugin_pay.closeConfirm: Close payment order {{no}}? It can no longer be paid.
plugin_pay.amountInvalid: Enter a valid payment no and amount
plugin_pay.configJsonError: Channel config must be a JSON object
plugin_pay.configKeep: Leave empty to keep existing config
plugin_pay.notifyUrlHint: Full callback URL of this site; defaults to the current origin

channel.deletedPartial: {{deleted}} of {{total}} selected channels deleted (the rest do not exist or belong to another tenant)
channel.methodPlaceholder: Select a method this channel supports

capabilities.title: Channel capabilities
capabilities.unknown: No capability matrix for this provider
capabilities.providerUnsupported: {{provider}} does not support “{{action}}”; the server rejects the request as well.
capabilities.noneAdvertised: {{provider}} advertises no supported values; confirm with the channel or pick another one.
capabilities.enforcedByServer: Disabling options here is only a convenience: the server validates the same capability matrix and rejects unsupported requests.

stats.name: Name
stats.stale: Refresh failed; showing the previous result
stats.emptyInRange: No payment orders in this range
stats.multiCurrency: Multiple currencies: amounts are listed per currency, never summed across.
stats.sampled: High volume: stats cover the most recent 20,000 orders.
stats.noFailures: No failed orders in this range

plugin_pay.loadFailed: Failed to load the list; data may be stale

auth.invalid: Select a channel and enter a valid amount
auth.invalidCapture: Enter an amount within the remaining balance
auth.noChannel: No channel available. Create one under Channels first.
auth.methodOptional: Optional: a method this channel supports
auth.payerIdRequiredForReal: Required by real channels; the channel rejects when it is missing — never guessed locally.

refundSync.noPerm: Requires the close/sync order permission to query the channel

outbox.description: Delivery ledger for funds events written in the same transaction as the status change. Failed publishes retry with backoff; exceeding the limit or an unparseable payload turns the row into a dead letter.
outbox.deadHint: Dead letters are never retried automatically: retry them or discard them with a note — silently marking them delivered is not allowed.
outbox.payloadEmpty: Payload is empty or not returned by the API
outbox.retryConfirm: Retry event {{id}}? Funds events may be consumed twice downstream; confirm the consumer has not already processed it.
outbox.discardHint: Discarding stops delivery for good (the dispatcher skips the row). Record why, so the decision can be audited later.
outbox.discardNotePlaceholder: e.g. compensated through reconciliation; no replay needed

reconcile.invalid: Select a channel and bill date
reconcile.emptyHint: Leave empty if the channel has no transactions; local payments will all be marked missing.
reconcile.sourceManualHint: Entered locally: type the channel-side amounts by hand; useful when the bill is not downloadable or you only spot-check.
reconcile.sourceChannelHint: Channel bill: the server downloads and parses the day's bill, so no manual amounts are needed. Unavailable when the channel cannot provide bills.
reconcile.pickChannelFirst: Pick a channel first: which source is available depends on that channel's capabilities.
reconcile.emptyBecauseFailed: The run failed and produced no differences; fix the reason above and run it again.
reconcile.channelBillEmpty: The channel bill has 0 rows: it may not be generated yet or the day had no transactions. Verify the bill date and re-run.

settle.confirmHint: Confirm settlement {{period}}? It can be paid after confirmation.
settle.pickSettlement: Select at least one confirmed settlement
settle.pickSettlementHint: Only confirmed settlements are listed; each settlement can belong to one batch.
settle.payoutPathManualHint: Manual receipt: the money already left the bank/offline channel; this only records the receipt number and never calls the channel.
settle.payoutPathChannelHint: Channel payout: calls the channel payout API to actually transfer money and stores the channel batch number. Unavailable when the channel cannot pay out.
settle.pickPayoutChannelFirst: Select the channel to pay out through
settle.noPayoutChannel: No channel supports payout: enable one under Channels, or use the manual receipt path.
settle.channelPayConfirm: Pay batch {{no}} through channel {{code}}? This transfers real money and uses the batch number as the idempotency key.
settle.payoutItemsHint: One failed transfer does not block the rest; “awaiting result” items are resolved by querying the channel in the background — never guessed locally.

probe.title: Channel check
probe.hint: Read-only probe: queries an order that cannot exist, downloads platform certificates, and parses keys. It never creates orders, refunds or transfers.
probe.skippedNote: {{count}} check(s) were not run because optional settings are missing — not run is not the same as passed.

probeCheck.gateway: Gateway reachable and accepted the signature
